description: This file defines a database migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically for version 4.0. It includes methods to create new database tables, add menu items, and update schema related to HR event data and OAuth client registration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class responsible for applying database schema changes during system upgrade to version 4.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs schema updates including creating tables and menu entries if they do not already exist.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.0' indicating the migration's target version.
